issues.summary: source file map freshness check reports stale without current source movement
issues.impact: doctor/source-map freshness validation fails during unrelated owner/docblock work, but AGENTS forbids regenerating without current source movement or provenance explaining the drift
issues.next_action: Inspect generated source-map diff in a focused docs/source-map maintenance pass; regenerate only if current BN/source provenance explains the drift

history.note: Issue recorded for future agent tooling/process repair.

Fixed by regenerating docs/reconstruction/source_file_map.md with python tools/recoil.py audit source-map --update --output docs/reconstruction/source_file_map.md. Freshness check and issue audit now pass. No tool defect was found.

issues.expected: source-map freshness check passes, or the map is regenerated during a provenance-backed source movement/update task

issues.resolution: Fixed by regenerating docs/reconstruction/source_file_map.md with python tools/recoil.py audit source-map --update --output docs/reconstruction/source_file_map.md. Freshness check and issue audit now pass. No tool defect was found.

issues.summary: README progress freshness check reports stale
issues.impact: doctor --quick --binja fails its README progress freshness check even when reconstruction source/owner checks pass, so future agents cannot report process health as clean.
issues.next_action: Run a focused README progress maintenance pass through the docs command path; keep README visitor-facing and do not mix it with reconstruction evidence.

history.note: Issue recorded for future agent tooling/process repair.

issues.expected: README progress freshness check either passes or has a focused docs-maintenance issue tracking the needed update.

issues.resolution: Fixed by refreshing README.md's generated public progress block via python tools/recoil.py docs readme-progress. The freshness check now passes, and python tools/recoil.py issue audit --strict passes. No tool or test repair was needed.

issues.summary: VC5 data-symbol verify over-reads BN hexdump for 0x4dadf4 short string
issues.impact: Blocks byte-gate evidence for shared ZRD read-failed literal even though BN data decl is char[0x12] and the manifest requests byte_length 18.
issues.next_action: Inspect BN hexdump parsing/request handling for short data-symbol final lines; ensure exact requested byte counts are parsed without consuming ASCII-column bytes.

history.note: Issue recorded for future agent tooling/process repair.

Fixed bytes_from_hexdump parsing in tools/_recoil/commands/asm_verify.py so short final hexdump lines do not consume ASCII-column hex-like text; added unittest coverage in tests/tools/recoil_asm_verify_tests.py; python -m unittest tests.tools.recoil_asm_verify_tests and python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4dadf4 passed.

issues.actual: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4dadf4 reports: BN hexdump yielded 19 byte(s), expected 18.
issues.repro: Run python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4dadf4 with tools/vc5_verify_targets/hud_ui_shared_zrd_literals_data.json present; compare BN get_data_decl for 0x4dadf4 showing char[0x12].
issues.resolution: Fixed bytes_from_hexdump parsing in tools/_recoil/commands/asm_verify.py so short final hexdump lines do not consume ASCII-column hex-like text; added unittest coverage in tests/tools/recoil_asm_verify_tests.py; python -m unittest tests.tools.recoil_asm_verify_tests and python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4dadf4 passed.
